verdict.rationale: The evidence only gives the building blocks. The platform can manage payouts for connected accounts and retrieve each account's balance via the API, so it could build its own seller-facing money views. Embedded components are evidenced only for onboarding, and nothing shows a ready-made seller self-serve reporting surface. Missing for 10: per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, bookkeeper-ready exports, an embedded seller-facing reporting/payouts component, and independent corroboration that sellers can close the month without platform support.
